output.answer: General Motors' latest 10-K is its fiscal-year 2025 annual report, filed with the SEC on January 27, 2026 (period ending 2025-12-31, accession no. 0001467858-26-000013). You can find it free on SEC EDGAR at the filing index https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785826000013/0001467858-26-000013-index.html, with the main document at gm-20251231.htm; the easiest route is to search "GM 10-K" on EDGAR (CIK 0001467858) or via GM's investor-relations site. An HTML iXBRL copy of the full filing and a PDF-style 2025 Annual Report version are both in EDGAR's archive for that accession.
caveats: GM's next 10-K (for fiscal year 2026) is not due until early 2027, so the January 27, 2026 filing remains the latest as of November 11, 2026; interim updates would appear in Form 10-Q and 8-K filings on the same EDGAR page.
EDGAR's browse page for CIK 0001467858 is the authoritative, always-current list of GM's 10-K filings if the URL above changes.
